facts.text: I am looking for new running shoes.
I finished a 5K run with a personal best time of 27 minutes and 42 seconds.
I think I land midfoot when I run.
I want to use the Nike Vaporfly Next% for speed workouts and shorter races.
I need a more durable shoe for my regular training runs.
My weekly mileage is around 60 to 70 miles.
I am thinking of getting the Brooks Ghost.
I have heard that the Brooks Ghost is heavier than some other shoes.
